$comment: The plane's AI Gateways (workspace decisions 0021 (f) and (h), 0037; docs/architecture/plane.md, Inference seam). Two gateways by data class, both unable to store: logs off (collect_logs), cache off (cache_ttl 0), no Logpush, no OpenTelemetry exporter. The strict one carries typed text after the phone's PII gate and blocks personal data with DLP; the documents one carries the whole-CV parse the user opted into, where the CV's own name and phone must pass, so it has no DLP (and DLP does not read images anyway). `authentication` is on (the founder, 2026-10-29; Cloudflare requires it on every new gateway and does not let it be turned off): a request to a gateway's paths must be authorized in the account, and the plane's binding calls are pre-authenticated there (Cloudflare's AI Gateway authentication docs), so the plane holds no gateway token; a token with AI Gateway Run only sends requests through gateways and cannot create, read or edit them, which the scripts need (AI Gateway Edit and Read, Zero Trust Read for the profiles). `dlp_profiles` names Cloudflare One DLP profiles and, in each, the detection entries to enable (the account's plan has two predefined profiles, listed 2026-10-29: Financial Information, and Social Security, Insurance, Tax, and Identifier Numbers; no Credentials and Secrets or Health Information profile; no Brazilian CPF or CNPJ or Mexican CURP or RFC detector, which the phone's gate covers). Cloudflare ships a predefined profile with every entry off, so a profile on the gateway detects nothing until its entries are on: the founder chose these on 2026-10-29 (the five card numbers, the labelled CVV, IBAN, SWIFT, the US ABA routing number and the US SSN; the other countries' identifiers and the "Text" variants stay off until the chat eval measures them) and turned them on in the Zero Trust dashboard; scripts/ai-gateway/apply.mjs sets a profile's enabled entries to this list (PUT dlp/profiles/predefined/<id> enabled_entries, Zero Trust Edit), and the labelled CVV, which the API marks unavailable on this plan, stays off until Cloudflare offers it. apply.mjs resolves the profiles to ids and sends `dlp` as `{ action, enabled, profiles }`, leaving the field out when DLP is off (the API refuses `{ enabled: false }` alone). scripts/ai-gateway/verify.mjs fails on any setting that could store, on authentication off, and on a profile with no enabled detector.
